id: \bI came to pray for my dearly departed Clefairy.
en: \bI came to pray for my dearly departed Clefairy.
it: \bSono venuto a pregare per il mio caro Clefairy scomparso.

id: \rPokémon Tower was erected in the memory of Pokémon that died.
en: \rPokémon Tower was erected in the memory of Pokémon that died.
it: \rLa Torre Pokémon è stata eretta in memoria dei Pokémon defunti.

id: \rThere are spirits up to mischief. I sense that high in the Tower.
en: \rThere are spirits up to mischief. I sense that high in the Tower.
it: \rCi sono spiriti che combinano guai. Li percepisco in cima alla Torre.

id: \bI can't stop worrying about everything that happened here.
en: \bI can't stop worrying about everything that happened here.
it: \bNon riesco a smettere di preoccuparmi per tutto quello che è successo qui.
\rIl mio Growlithe...\nPerché te ne sei andato?
\rChe tu sia benedetto, cuore amante dei Pokémon.
